events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
A Roman governor rules Judea; Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church begins in Jerusalem; Herod Agrippa I rules Judea (AD 41-44), then Roman governors again.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Tiberius is emperor; Pilate governs Judea.
Claudius (AD 41-54), then Nero (AD 54-68); Jews expelled from Rome under Claudius.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Probably written, perhaps between the 60s and 90s AD (date debated)

teaser.title: The church begins
teaser.text: Pentecost is usually placed around AD 30.

teaser.title: Acts is written
teaser.text: Most scholars say the 60s to 90s AD. The date is debated.

teaser.title: Paul reaches Rome
teaser.text: Acts ends with Paul under house arrest in Rome, perhaps about AD 60 to 62.
